continuation_pr.title: feat(storage): recover validated PNG images to reviewed new ZIPs
continuation_pr.body:
## Why

Advance Stage 6 of the storage roadmap with recovery of complete supported PNG images from a bounded damaged file or image. The implementation, source reconciliations and qualification state are preserved as incremental remote checkpoints.

## Resulting behavior

- **Recover PNG images to ZIP…** is available for one native local regular file of at most 64 MiB, through the context menu, Tools menu and command palette.
- The scan reviews candidate source ranges, dimensions and findings. Only validated noninterlaced 8-bit grayscale/RGB/gray-alpha/RGBA PNGs are selectable. CRCs, chunk ordering, complete zlib framing/Adler, exact scanline lengths and filter bytes must pass.
- Selected PNGs and `recovery-report.json` are written to a separately verified new ZIP. The report retains source offsets, hashes, classifications and coverage; no original filesystem names are claimed.
- The shared queue owns admitted work. Publication rehashes source and staged output after the durable committing checkpoint. A new native exclusive-publication guard checks captured authority/cancellation synchronously after the final asynchronous path probe; pause epochs force fresh proofs, including a transient pause/resume.
- Existing destinations and source files are retained. A completed install remains successful if Stop or a completion observer arrives afterward. Restart requires a fresh scan and review; the journal retains digests/receipts, not source bytes.
- No runtime dependency was added. New code is original MIT; the existing source inventory records SHA-256 integrity use without changing encryption or distribution decisions.

## Reconciliation

Current saved head: **71c14b98a9e4824dc613b6bb3d77e11b2cc49c9f**. Runtime source checkpoint: **97e6aa18625e74169c085085ecaecd9adf917283**.

The 15 November 08:06 UTC cutoff incorporates:

- Main `5b7daacc`, including merged Word PR #112.
- Worksheet navigation through `d97705da`: newer font-aware capture code, retained hosted evidence and the latest separate local status.
- All six commits of `feature/new-documents-history-20261115` through `ab94bedb`: new documents, reviewed conversion copies, persistent recent-file history, save-aware editor handoff, active-pane indicators and translations.
- Previously included Excel `ca6156e8`, DOC recovery and Office reconciliation work.

The four shared source/document files preserve both incoming document commands and existing PNG recovery actions. The other 33 document-workspace paths use their exact incoming blobs.

All **2,220 managed Office files** match the canonical Git blob identities, sizes and modes at Quds `b23d033620f07cf2659209eff4c4c8e2d71ee89c` and standalone parser `d422fa99a3a84830794f0e2dc332d59f923779f7`. Commit `6e9284e3` corrects 41 pre-existing executable flags on Dart files without changing their contents. The newer canonical-main merge does not replace the Linux golden correction.

## Validation status

**Local runtime qualification is blocked by exhausted workspace capacity; it is not running. This PR remains a draft.**

Completed in this continuation:

- Verified the complete 10,413-file source union: no unintended additions, omissions or changes.
- Read back all four merged files and checked exact content. Incoming hunks reproduce the incoming source from its common base, match unique context in the integration source and reverse to the unchanged pre-merge source.
- Verified all 2,220 managed Office blob identities, sizes and modes, complete standalone inventory and pin declarations.
- Saved progress in six incremental remote commits, including the audit and qualification handoff.
- Expanded the app test manifest from 31 to **41 suites**, adding the ten relevant new/changed document-workspace test suites.

**No fresh Flutter/Dart suite executed in this continuation.** The recovered `c68c03ae` branch did not contain the final raw receipts described in the pasted handoff. Earlier reported test totals remain historical and are not acceptance for this combined source. A full local manifest SHA-256 rehash also remains pending; the completed comparison used canonical committed Git blob identities.

The filesystem prevents shell and patch-tool startup with `No space left on device`. Cleanup through elevated execution was rejected because the workspace disables sandbox escalation; the computer-use runtime was unavailable. Source and audit work were nevertheless saved directly to the remote branch.

Per the user's instruction, **no GitHub Actions run was awaited or restarted**. The saved continuation lists the remaining source-bound local app/editor/engine, strict analysis, inventory, portable VM/JavaScript/Python and preview checks, with immediate remote saving after each gate.

[Current continuation and exact remaining work](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/71c14b98a9e4824dc613b6bb3d77e11b2cc49c9f/docs/evidence/storage-carving-20261115/resume-0806/README.md) · [Profile and limits](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/71c14b98a9e4824dc613b6bb3d77e11b2cc49c9f/docs/archive-png-carving.md) · [Office reconciliation](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/71c14b98a9e4824dc613b6bb3d77e11b2cc49c9f/docs/office-storage-reconciliation-20261115.md)

## Boundaries

64 MiB input/output and separate bounded parser-work/expansion limits. Indexed/interlaced/animated PNGs, other bit depths, unknown/compressed ancillary chunks and smaller zlib windows explicitly decline. Fragment reconstruction, original names/directories, physical devices, rescue imaging, undelete and JPEG/PDF carving remain future profiles.

Portable core acceptance does not enable browser/cloud publication or establish other-platform execution. The native verify/rename boundary is not atomic compare-and-swap against arbitrary external writers. This is a draft implementation review, not a signed release or broad Office rendering/schema acceptance.

odf_pr.title: Preview legacy .xls through Quds, edit ODS, enrich ODT/ODP
odf_pr.body:
Follow-up to #108 (merged) and CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite#23.

## Legacy Excel preview
- F3 on `.xls`/`.xlt` imports BIFF into the shared model and renders a typed, formula-aware **read-only grid** (styles, merges, freeze). A **Grid/Legacy** toggle keeps the File Viewer spreadsheet grid as the explicit alternative and automatic fallback. `.xlsb` stays on the File Viewer route.

## ODS
- `.ods` is imported by Quds (`OdsSheetReader`): typed values, repeated rows/columns, spans/covered cells, ODF formulas translated to A1, cell styles, number formats, column widths and row heights.
- **F4 editing**: import → sheet editor; Save writes a new `.xlsx` copy and never rewrites the original `.ods`.
- F3 table extraction now keeps numbers/types, repeats and merges.

## ODT
- Inline bold/italic via text styles, safe links, ordered/unordered and nested lists, numbered footnote bodies, repeat/span-aware tables and image markers.

## ODP
- Real slide deck model: page size from the page layout, frames/custom shapes with positions and sizes, text styles/colours, fills, images, page backgrounds and speaker notes; rendered by the existing slide viewer.

## Boundaries
- ODF has no writer in Quds; saving an imported ODS produces `.xlsx`.
- ODT/ODP remain read-only; ODT images are textual markers.
- ODF no longer offers the OOXML PDF tab.

## Verification
- `flutter analyze` clean for the four touched files.
- `office_document_service_test.dart` 14 tests (ODS typed/repeats/merge, ODT rich text/lists/notes, ODP deck).
- Engine ODS/legacy reader tests pass; vendored pin `e002b95` (fork PR #23).
